root: ^She crosses her arms but not out of anger—more like bracing herself.
^"But it’s ours. We built it from nothing, away from the city’s rules. People fight hard to keep it safe."
^She turns to you, her eyes searching.
^"Let’s head to the square. Someone will want to talk to you—probably the Elder."
^"Just… be patient with them. We don’t get many strangers."
